$comment: The upgrade safety contract. Machine-readable mirror of the 'Who owns what' section in AGENTS.md — read them together. Consumed by UPGRADE.md (what an upgrade may touch) and by scripts/check-template-version.ts (release discipline in CI). Patterns are exact file paths or '<dir>/**'. Precedence: the match with the longest literal prefix wins (so 'server/queries/index.ts' beats 'server/queries/**' beats 'server/**'). A path matching NO pattern is builder-owned.

rules.synapseOwned: The template's to manage: an upgrade recipe may overwrite these from the template, add new files, or delete files the template has removed. LIMIT: a pattern here claims only paths that exist in the template at the target version — a file that matches (say, server/notes.ts) but was created by the builder is builder-owned by definition, and upgrades never touch it.
rules.shared: Both sides edit these. Upgrades change them only through the guided edits written in an UPGRADES.md entry — never a blind copy — and every guided edit must preserve the builder's additions.
rules.builderOwned: The builder's app. Upgrades NEVER overwrite, edit, or delete anything here. Creating a NEW file at a path the clone doesn't have (e.g. a new theme preset file) is allowed; touching an existing one is not. Everything not matched by any pattern is builder-owned too.
